Research Software Engineer

Example Research Institute is looking for a Research Software Engineer to join our bioinformatics data platform team. You will design and build pipelines that process genomic sequencing data at scale, working closely with researchers across several labs.

What you will do

  • Design and maintain Python-based data processing pipelines for genomic datasets.
  • Collaborate with researchers to translate analysis needs into reusable software.
  • Operate and monitor pipelines running on a Kubernetes-based compute cluster.
  • Write automated tests and documentation so pipelines stay maintainable over time.

What we are looking for

  • A completed degree in computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Several years of professional experience with Python and SQL.
  • Experience with containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes) in a cloud environment.
  • Comfortable working directly with scientific researchers on ambiguous problems.

We offer a competitive salary, a hybrid working policy, and the chance to work on software that directly accelerates biomedical research. The position is based in Utrecht, with two days of remote work per week.
